name: Wash kit 707
desc: A soft RolandTR707 kit drowned in deliberate room: buried kick/backbeat with washy closed+open hats, a slow filter breath over 32 cycles, gentle onset pump and a double-time fill every eighth bar. The beat sits under the haze, MBV-style.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR707"), s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.7), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR707").fast(${rate}).gain(.4), s("~ ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.35)).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.4).slow(32)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(4)).room(${room}).size(.82).shape(.4).every(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ bd <bd sd>").bank("RolandTR707"), s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.72), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR707").fast(${rate}).gain(.32), s("~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.35), s("cp(3,8,<0 2>)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.28)).lpf(sine.range(${cut},${cut}*1.7).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(4)).room(${room}).size(.85).shape(.45).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
